sources.title_en: Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange

Art.7 prohibition on splitting to evade quota supervision and on false commercial documents
Art.13 overseas individual may purchase FX and remit legitimate current-account RMB income earned in China
Art.22 overseas individual sale of domestic commercial property: FX purchase and remittance subject to SAFE approval
Art.26 outward transfer of an overseas individual's legitimate domestic property
Art.30 individual FX trading must go through qualified domestic financial institutions
Art.37 definitions of domestic individual and overseas individual

sources.title_en: Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange (as amended)
sources.title_zh: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则（已修改）
used_for: Art.2 annual total amount = USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year, applying to individual FX settlement and domestic-individual FX purchase
Art.13(1) overseas individual purchases FX against legitimate current-account RMB income with ID and supporting documents including tax vouchers
Art.13(2) reconversion of previously exchanged unused RMB; original exchange receipt valid 24 months; USD 500/day and USD 1,000 at departure-port exceptions
Art.14 domestic individual remitting FX abroad for current-account purposes: USD 50,000/day from FX savings account on ID alone
Art.15(1) overseas individual remitting FX abroad from FX savings account: valid ID only
Art.20 emigration and inheritance property transfer handled under the 2004 Interim Measures
Art.21 overseas individual purchase/sale of domestic commercial property and equity transfers of real-estate enterprises
Art.25 FX settlement account for individual foreign-trade operators and individually-owned businesses managed as an institutional account
Art.30 FX cash withdrawal: USD 10,000/day direct, above requires prior SAFE filing

Art.39 (abolished by Huifa [2023] No.8, Annex 3)

used_for: Art.5 the State does not restrict current-account international payments and transfers
Art.22 para.3 a lawfully terminated foreign-invested enterprise may, after liquidation and tax payment, purchase FX and remit the RMB belonging to foreign investors
Art.39 penalty for evading FX supervision / transferring domestic FX or capital abroad
Art.40 penalty for illegal FX arbitrage incl. fraudulent FX purchase on false or invalid documents
Art.42 penalty for carrying FX across the border in violation of rules
Art.44 penalty for unauthorised change of use of FX or settled FX funds
Art.45 penalty for private, disguised or intermediary buying and selling of FX
Art.48 penalty for failing to declare balance-of-payments statistics or submitting untrue documents
Art.52(2) definition of domestic individual for the purposes of this Regulation

sources.title_en: SAFE Spokesman Addresses Press Conference on the Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局有关负责人就《个人外汇管理办法实施细则》答记者问
used_for: Official English statement that the annual individual FX purchase quota was raised from USD 20,000 to USD 50,000
Official English statement that FX settlement accounts for individual foreign-trade operators are managed as institutional accounts and are not subject to the annual quota

sources.title_en: Individual Foreign Exchange Business Q&A (II)
sources.title_zh: 个人外汇业务解答（二）
used_for: Confirms an overseas individual may purchase FX and remit it out against legitimate current-account RMB income earned in China and against previously exchanged unused RMB, under Art.13 of Huifa [2007] No.1

sources.title_en: Interim Measures for the Administration of the Purchase of Foreign Exchange and Outward Remittance for the Transfer of Individual Property Abroad
sources.title_zh: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法
used_for: Art.2 defines emigration transfer and inheritance transfer
Art.3 property must be lawfully owned by the applicant and free of dispute
Art.5 application is made to the SAFE branch at the emigrant's former place of household registration, or the decedent's lifetime place of household registration

Art.6 emigration transfer must be applied for in one go for the full amount and remitted in stages: first tranche up to half; after one year up to half of the remainder; after two years the balance. Totals at or below RMB 200,000 equivalent may be remitted at once after approval
Art.8(4) requires public-security proof of cancellation of Chinese household registration plus a settlement-abroad certificate issued or authenticated by a Chinese embassy or consulate
Art.8(6) requires a tax certificate or tax-paid voucher from the competent tax authority
Art.9 inheritance transfer documents for a foreign-citizen heir
Art.10 approval thresholds: RMB 500,000 equivalent or less by the local SAFE branch; above that referred to SAFE headquarters
Art.11 the bank must remit directly to the applicant's own account in the country of residence; domestic FX cash withdrawal is prohibited
Art.13 penalties for obtaining FX by false materials or duplicate application

sources.title_en: PBOC Issues and Implements the Interim Measures for the Transfer of Individual Property Abroad
sources.title_zh: 中国人民银行发布实施《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》
used_for: Confirms that SAFE will not accept applications for property under judicial or supervisory restriction, property that cannot be shown to have a lawful source, or property involved in unresolved criminal or civil proceedings
Confirms the 'one application, staged remittance over two years' design for emigration transfers above RMB 200,000

sources.title_en: Notice of the SAFE on Regulating Large Overseas Cash Withdrawals by Bank Cards
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局关于规范银行卡境外大额提取现金交易的通知
sources.host: boc.cn (Bank of China, state-owned; republication of the SAFE notice and SAFE spokesperson Q&A)
sources.officiality_note: FLAGGED. The regulator's own text was not located at a safe.gov.cn URL during this session. Values below are taken from Bank of China's verbatim republication of the SAFE notice and of the SAFE spokesperson's answers to press questions, and are cross-checked against multiple independent republications.
used_for: Aggregate annual overseas cash withdrawal cap of RMB 100,000 equivalent per person across all cards (including supplementary cards) in the cardholder's own name
Per-card daily overseas cash withdrawal cap of RMB 10,000 equivalent, unifying the former RMB-card and foreign-currency-card limits
Exceeding the annual cap suspends overseas cash withdrawal for the current and the following year
Prohibition on using another person's card or lending one's own card to evade the cap
SAFE statement that overseas card consumption for current-account items is unaffected and does not consume the USD 50,000 annual facilitation quota

sources.title_en: SAFE Circular on Foreign Exchange Violation Cases
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局关于外汇违规案例的通报
used_for: Published administrative penalties for split FX purchases using other individuals' annual quotas
Published administrative penalties for fabricated trade backgrounds
Published administrative penalties for unauthorised overseas card transactions

sources.title_en: SAFE Circular on Foreign Exchange Violation Cases
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局关于外汇违规案例的通报
used_for: Published penalties for split purchase and remittance of FX through 303 individuals' annual quotas (bank fined RMB 1,000,000)
Published penalties for underground-bank FX dealings by individuals
Published penalty for private FX purchase of RMB 312,000,000 used to buy overseas property (RMB 24,970,000 fine)

sources.title_en: SAFE Circular on Foreign Exchange Violation Cases (III)
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局关于外汇违规案例的通报（三）
used_for: Published penalties for split FX purchases across 21, 34 and 173 individuals' annual quotas
Confirms that offenders are placed on the SAFE watch list and entered into the PBOC credit-reference system

sources.title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Criminal Cases of Illegal Engagement in Fund Payment and Settlement Business and Illegal Trading of Foreign Exchange
sources.title_zh: 最高人民法院 最高人民检察院关于办理非法从事资金支付结算业务、非法买卖外汇刑事案件适用法律若干问题的解释
sources.issuer: Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate
used_for: Art.2 disguised or resale trading of FX, where serious, is punished as the crime of illegal business operation under Criminal Law Art.225(4)
Art.3 'serious circumstances': illegal business amount of RMB 5,000,000 or more, or illegal gains of RMB 100,000 or more; reduced to RMB 2,500,000 / RMB 50,000 with aggravating factors
Art.4 'especially serious circumstances': illegal business amount of RMB 25,000,000 or more, or illegal gains of RMB 500,000 or more
Art.7 where illegal gains cannot be determined they are deemed to be one thousandth of the illegal business amount, with a fine of one to five times that amount

sources.title_en: Individual Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China (seventh amendment)
sources.title_zh: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法
sources.issuer: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
used_for: Art.1 resident individual = domicile in China, or no domicile but 183 days or more in a tax year; residents taxed on domestic and foreign income
Art.3(1) comprehensive income: 3% to 45% progressive
Art.3(2) business income: 5% to 35% progressive
Art.3(3) interest, dividends, bonuses, property leasing, property transfer and incidental income: proportional rate of 20%
Art.6(5) property transfer taxable income = transfer revenue less original value and reasonable expenses
Art.6(6) interest, dividends and bonuses taxable on the full amount of each receipt
Art.6 para.3 remuneration for personal services and royalties are taken at 80% of revenue as the income amount
Art.6 para.1 comprehensive income less RMB 60,000 and deductions
Art.7 credit for foreign tax paid by a resident individual on overseas income, capped at the PRC tax computed under this Law
Art.8 anti-avoidance adjustments incl. non-distribution by a controlled enterprise in a low-tax jurisdiction
Art.10(4) self-filing required on obtaining overseas income
Art.10(5) and Art.13 para.5 tax clearance must be completed before cancelling Chinese household registration on emigration
Art.13 para.3 residents must file on overseas income between 1 March and 30 June of the following year
Art.15 the registration authority must verify the individual income tax paid certificate before registering a transfer of immovable property or of equity
Art.16 income is computed in RMB; foreign-currency income is converted at the RMB central parity rate

sources.title_en: Regulations for the Implementation of the Enterprise Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China
sources.title_zh: 中华人民共和国企业所得税法实施条例
used_for: Art.91 income of a non-resident enterprise under Art.27(5) of the Enterprise Income Tax Law is taxed at a reduced rate of 10%

Art.91 exemptions: interest on loans from foreign governments to the Chinese government; interest on concessional loans from international financial organisations to the Chinese government and resident enterprises
Art.7(4) dividends are sourced where the distributing enterprise is located
Art.7(5) interest, rent and royalties are sourced where the payer is located
Art.49 management fees between enterprises, and rent and royalties between operating units of the same enterprise, are not deductible

sources.title_en: Supplementary Announcement on Tax Filing for Outbound Payments under Service Trade and Other Items
sources.title_zh: 国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局关于服务贸易等项目对外支付税务备案有关问题的补充公告
sources.issuer: State Taxation Administration and State Administration of Foreign Exchange
used_for: Confirms that a single outbound payment not exceeding USD 50,000 equivalent requires no tax filing, per STA/SAFE Announcement 2013 No.40
Where the same contract requires multiple outbound payments, filing is required only once, before the first payment that exceeds USD 50,000 equivalent
Reinvestment in China by a foreign investor out of legitimate domestic direct-investment income is exempt from the filing
The filing is completed through the electronic tax bureau and the bank processes the remittance against the filing number and verification code

sources.title_en: Notice on Further Preventing and Handling the Risks of Speculation in Virtual Currency Transactions
sources.title_zh: 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知
sources.issuer: PBOC, Cyberspace Administration, Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, MIIT, Ministry of Public Security, SAMR, CBIRC, CSRC and SAFE (ten agencies)
used_for: Para 1(1) virtual currencies including Bitcoin, Ether and so-called stablecoins such as Tether have no legal-tender status and must not circulate as currency

Para 1(2) virtual-currency-related business activities are illegal financial activities: fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-crypto exchange, acting as central counterparty, information intermediary and pricing services, token issuance financing and crypto derivatives are strictly prohibited and banned; criminal liability follows where a crime is constituted
Para 1(3) overseas crypto exchanges serving mainland residents over the internet are equally illegal financial activities
Para 1(4) civil acts of investing in virtual currency that offend public order and good morals are void and losses are borne by the participant
Para 4(9) financial institutions and non-bank payment institutions must not open accounts, transfer funds or provide clearing and settlement for virtual-currency activities

sources.title_en: Notice of the SAFE and the Ministry of Construction on Regulating Foreign Exchange Administration of the Real Estate Market
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局 建设部关于规范房地产市场外汇管理有关问题的通知
used_for: Art.2 an overseas individual who has worked or studied in China for more than one year may buy self-use residential property

Art.5 RMB proceeds of a transfer of purchased domestic commercial property by an overseas individual may be converted and remitted only after the local SAFE branch confirms the FX purchase application, the transfer contract and the tax-paid certificate for the transfer of property rights
Art.4 refund of unconverted purchase funds on a failed transaction

sources.title_en: Answers to Questions on Individual Capital-Account Foreign Exchange Business
sources.title_zh: 个人资本项目外汇业务释疑
used_for: States that an overseas individual (foreign national, Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan resident, or overseas Chinese) realising lawfully owned domestic commercial property may purchase FX and remit the proceeds directly at a bank, without applying to SAFE and without a time limit

Where property is matrimonial joint property, the share attributable to a domestic individual cannot be remitted because there is no policy support for domestic individuals buying overseas real property; the overseas individual's share is processed as legitimate domestic income of an overseas individual

sources.title_en: Operational Guidelines for Facilitation Policies on Cross-Border Investment and Financing Foreign Exchange Administration (annex to Huifa [2025] No.43)
sources.title_zh: 深化跨境投融资外汇管理便利化政策操作指引
used_for: Item 8 sets out the documentary requirements for an overseas individual's purchase of domestic commercial property and for the conversion and remittance of proceeds from transferring it
The amount remitted may not exceed the transfer price less the taxes and fees of the transfer; for co-owners, not more than the applicant's share of the after-tax balance
Lists the underlying rules: State Council Decree No.532, Huifa [2006] No.47, Jianfang [2010] No.186, Jianfang [2015] No.122, Huifa [2012] No.59
Lists the direct-investment rules: Huifa [2013] No.21, Huifa [2015] No.13, Huifa [2016] No.16

sources.title_en: Notice of the SAFE on Further Simplifying and Improving the Foreign Exchange Administration Policies for Direct Investment
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局关于进一步简化和改进直接投资外汇管理政策的通知
used_for: Abolishes SAFE approval for inward and outward direct-investment FX registration; banks now review and process registration directly through the SAFE capital-account information system

Only after completing direct-investment FX registration may an entity open the related accounts and carry out FX conversion and remittance, including remittance or repatriation of profits and dividends
Replaces the annual FX inspection with an annual stock-of-equity-rights registration to be filed by 30 September each year
Entities that fail to file are placed under system business controls and banks may not process their capital-account FX business

sources.title_en: Xiamen Branch Service Tips on Individual Foreign Exchange Business
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局厦门市分局个人外汇业务服务小贴士
used_for: An overseas individual converting legitimate current-account RMB income earned in China does not complete the Individual FX Purchase Application form
An overseas individual holding a Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card is subject to the annual facilitation quota for FX purchase
Tax vouchers issued by the tax authority are part of the supporting documents for an overseas individual's FX purchase
Reconversion of previously exchanged unused RMB up to USD 500 equivalent per day may be done on valid ID alone

sources.title_en: Beijing Branch Guidance on Individual Foreign Exchange Business (document checklist)
sources.title_zh: 个人外汇业务办理指引（资料清单）
used_for: Document checklist for property-transfer and incidental-income remittances: property title certificate, sale contract or demolition-compensation agreement, genuine transaction records
Requires the original tax certificate from the competent tax authority, save where the rules dispense with it

sources.title_en: Figuring the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion
used_for: Maximum foreign earned income exclusion of USD 130,000 per qualifying person for tax year 2025 and USD 132,900 for tax year 2026
Married spouses who both qualify may exclude up to USD 260,000 for 2025
Housing amount limitation is generally 30% of the maximum exclusion: USD 39,000 for 2025 and USD 39,870 for 2026
The maximum exclusion is USD 126,500 for tax year 2024
Part-year qualification is prorated by qualifying days over 365 (366 in a leap year)

sources.title_en: Foreign Earned Income Exclusion
used_for: A US citizen or resident alien living abroad is taxed on worldwide income

Qualification requires foreign earned income, a foreign tax home, and either bona fide residence for an uninterrupted period including an entire tax year or physical presence for at least 330 full days in any twelve consecutive months
Pensions, annuities and social security benefits are not foreign earned income
The exclusion does not reduce self-employment tax

sources.title_en: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
used_for: A US person must file FinCEN Form 114 where the aggregate value of foreign financial accounts exceeded USD 10,000 at any time during the calendar year
Whether an account produced taxable income is irrelevant to whether it is a foreign financial account
Due 15 April with an automatic extension to 15 October; filed electronically through FinCEN's BSA E-Filing System, not with the tax return
Records must be kept for five years from the FBAR due date
Civil penalty maximums under Title 31 are adjusted annually for inflation per 31 CFR 1010.821

sources.title_en: 31 CFR 1010.821 - Penalty adjustment and table
sources.issuer: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, Department of the Treasury
sources.as_of: eCFR current to 2026-11-05; amounts are those for penalties assessed on or after 17 January 2025
used_for: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) non-willful foreign financial agency transaction violation: statutory USD 10,000, adjusted maximum USD 16,536
31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) willful foreign financial agency transaction violation: statutory USD 100,000, adjusted maximum USD 165,353
31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(1) general civil penalty for willful violations of Bank Secrecy Act requirements: statutory USD 25,000 to USD 100,000, adjusted USD 71,545 to USD 286,184
12 U.S.C. 1829b(j) recordkeeping violations for funds transfers: statutory USD 10,000, adjusted USD 26,262
31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(6)(A) negligent violation: statutory USD 500, adjusted USD 1,430; (a)(6)(B) pattern of negligent activity: statutory USD 50,000, adjusted USD 111,308

sources.title_en: Instructions for Form 8938, Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets
used_for: Unmarried or married filing separately, living in the United States: more than USD 50,000 on the last day of the tax year or more than USD 75,000 at any time during it
Married filing jointly, living in the United States: more than USD 100,000 on the last day or more than USD 150,000 at any time
Unmarried or married filing separately, living outside the United States: more than USD 200,000 on the last day or more than USD 300,000 at any time
Married filing jointly, living outside the United States: more than USD 400,000 on the last day or more than USD 600,000 at any time
Specified domestic entity: more than USD 50,000 on the last day or more than USD 75,000 at any time

sources.title_en: Publication 514 (2025), Foreign Tax Credit for Individuals
used_for: Four creditability tests: imposed on you, paid or accrued, your legal and actual foreign tax liability, and an income tax or a tax in lieu of an income tax
The credit cannot exceed total US tax liability multiplied by foreign-source taxable income over total taxable income
Separate limitation categories including section 951A, foreign branch, passive, general, section 901(j) and income re-sourced by treaty
One-year carryback and ten-year carryover of unused foreign tax
No credit or deduction for foreign taxes paid on income excluded under the foreign earned income or foreign housing exclusions

De minimis election to claim the credit without Form 1116 where creditable foreign taxes do not exceed USD 300 (USD 600 on a joint return) and all foreign-source gross income is passive category income reported on qualified payee statements
A nonresident alien generally cannot claim the credit

sources.title_en: Publication 54 (12/2025), Tax Guide for U.S. Citizens and Resident Aliens Abroad
used_for: Amounts reported on a US return must be expressed in US dollars; foreign currency must be translated, and all federal income tax determinations are made in the taxpayer's functional currency, which is generally the US dollar
FinCEN Form 105 must be filed where currency or monetary instruments totalling more than USD 10,000 at one time are physically transported, mailed or shipped into or out of the United States
Form 8938 must be filed with Form 1040 where specified foreign financial assets exceed the applicable reporting threshold
Automatic two-month extension to 15 June where the taxpayer's tax home and abode are outside the United States and Puerto Rico on the regular due date

sources.title_en: Treasury Department Technical Explanation of the Agreement between the United States of America and the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Tax Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income
sources.issuer: US Department of the Treasury / Internal Revenue Service
used_for: Agreement signed at Beijing on 30 April 1984 with an accompanying Protocol and exchange of letters; Second Protocol signed at Beijing on 10 May 1986; general effective date under Article 27 is 1 January 1987
Article 9 Dividends: paragraph 2 caps source-state tax at 10 percent of the gross dividend where the beneficial owner is a resident of the other Contracting State

Article 10 Interest: paragraph 2 caps source-state tax at 10 percent of the gross interest; paragraph 3 exempts interest derived by the government, a political subdivision, the central bank or a wholly government-owned financial institution

Article 11 Royalties: paragraph 2 caps source-state tax at 10 percent of the gross royalty; paragraph 6 of the Protocol taxes equipment leasing on 70 percent of the gross amount, an effective cap of 7 percent

Article 12 Gains: paragraph 1 real property may be taxed where situated; paragraph 4 shares of a property-rich company may be taxed where the real property is situated; paragraph 5 a participation of 25 percent or more in a resident company may be taxed in that State
Article 13 Independent Personal Services: taxable in the other State only if present more than 183 days in the calendar year or a fixed base is regularly available

Article 22 Elimination of Double Taxation: the United States allows a credit for income taxes paid to China by or on behalf of a US resident or citizen, and for Chinese tax on the profits out of which dividends are paid to a US company owning at least 10 percent of the voting rights
Paragraph 2 of the Protocol is a saving clause preserving the right of the United States to tax its citizens and residents under domestic law
Article 3 of the Protocol: US social security taxes are not covered by the Agreement

sources.title_en: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act - FATCA Agreements and Understandings by Jurisdiction
used_for: China's entry reads: Status 'Agreement in Substance'; IGA 'Model 1'; no signed agreement linked; treated as having an IGA in effect from 30 June 2014
China therefore has no FATCA intergovernmental agreement in force, unlike the many jurisdictions listed as 'In Force' with a dated signed agreement

sources.title_en: FATCA Reporting on U.S. Accounts: Recent Legal Developments (Appendix, Countries with IGAs in Effect)
used_for: Corroborates that China is classified as 'Agreement in Substance', Model 1, with a treated-in-effect date of 30 June 2014 and no date of entry into force

sources.title_en: Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect 2.0 launched in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
sources.title_zh: 粤港澳大湾区“跨境理财通”2.0正式启动
sources.issuer: Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee (Guangdong provincial government portal)
sources.doc_number: News release reporting the revised Implementation Rules issued by the PBOC Guangdong Provincial Branch and co-regulators
sources.officiality_note: This is an official provincial-government portal reporting the revised Implementation Rules. The primary rule text is issued by the PBOC Guangdong Provincial Branch jointly with the HKMA and the AMCM and was not retrieved from those regulators' own sites during this session.
used_for: Individual investor quota raised from RMB 1,000,000 to RMB 3,000,000; where an investor uses both a bank and a securities company, RMB 1,500,000 each

Southbound eligibility: household registration in the nine mainland GBA cities, or continuous social insurance or individual income tax paid in those cities for two years; at least two years of investment experience; and family financial net assets of at least RMB 1,000,000 at month end over the last three months, or family financial assets of at least RMB 2,000,000, or personal average annual income of at least RMB 400,000 over the last three years
Securities companies added to the pilot; northbound eligible products extended to include mainland selling banks' RMB deposits and public mutual funds of risk grades R1 to R4
As at end-January 2024 there were 71,000 individual investors in the scheme, with RMB 13.8 billion of cross-boundary remittances

sources.title_en: Notice of the SAFE on Regulating the Administration of Banks' Foreign Currency Cards
sources.title_zh: 国家外汇管理局关于规范银行外币卡管理的通知
sources.doc_number: Huifa [2010] No.53 (listed in the SAFE Gazette)
used_for: SAFE Gazette listing the instruments governing bank card foreign exchange business, used to establish the regulatory framework for overseas card use

sources.title_en: Individual Foreign Exchange Business Q&A (V)
sources.title_zh: 个人外汇业务解答（五）
used_for: The regulations do not impose a time limit on an overseas individual converting legitimately earned domestic RMB income into FX, but the individual must be able to produce evidence of when and how the income was earned, and the bank conducts an authenticity review under the three-principles-of-business-conduct standard

sources.title_en: Individual Foreign Exchange Business Q&A (III)
sources.title_zh: 个人外汇业务解答（三）
used_for: An overseas individual employed by a domestic enterprise may convert RMB salary into FX and remit it, either personally or by authorising the employer's finance staff or another person to act

sources.title_en: Individual Foreign Exchange Business Q&A (I)
sources.title_zh: 个人外汇业务解答（一）
used_for: Where the beneficiary of an insurance policy is an overseas person, insurance proceeds may be converted and remitted if the purchase of the insurance was itself lawful and compliant, processed as legitimate RMB income of an overseas individual against the insurance contract and the insurer's payment proof

sources.title_en: Enterprise Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China
sources.title_zh: 中华人民共和国企业所得税法
sources.issuer: National People's Congress, as republished by the State Taxation Administration
used_for: Art.2 definitions of resident enterprise and non-resident enterprise

Art.3 resident enterprises taxed on income from China and outside China; a non-resident enterprise with no establishment in China, or whose income is not effectively connected with its establishment, is taxed on its China-source income
Art.4 paragraph 1 the enterprise income tax rate is 25%
Art.4 paragraph 2 income of a non-resident enterprise under Art.3 paragraph 3 bears a statutory rate of 20%
Art.19 taxable income of a non-resident enterprise: gross amount for dividends, interest, rent and royalties; gross revenue less net value of the property for property transfers
Art.26(2) dividends and other equity investment income between qualifying resident enterprises are exempt
Art.27(5) income under Art.3 paragraph 3 may be exempted or reduced

sources.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration on Comprehensively Launching the Pilot Programme of Replacing Business Tax with Value Added Tax, Annex 1: Implementation Measures for the Pilot Programme
sources.title_zh: 财政部 国家税务总局关于全面推开营业税改征增值税试点的通知 附件1：营业税改征增值税试点实施办法
sources.issuer: Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration
used_for: Art.15(1) the VAT rate on taxable acts is 6% except where paragraphs (2), (3) or (4) apply
Art.15(2) transport, postal, basic telecom, construction and immovable property leasing services, sales of immovable property and transfers of land use rights at 11% as originally enacted
Art.15(3) leasing of tangible movable property at 17% as originally enacted
Art.10(2) a sale by an overseas entity or individual of an intangible asset used entirely outside China to a domestic entity or individual is a non-taxable activity

Annex 4 list of cross-border supplies to an overseas party consumed entirely outside China, including telecom, intellectual property, logistics auxiliary, assurance and consulting, professional technical and business auxiliary services, advertising placed overseas, and intangible assets
Art.3 the annual taxable-sales threshold for general taxpayer registration is RMB 5,000,000
